integrity: Full proof and independent finite-field rank enumerators included; finite experiments are not used as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the free class-two nilpotent Lie algebra with the exterior-square bracket is considered. Classification and counts are uniform for finite fields. No classification of other two-step nilpotent Lie algebras or independent mathematical audit is asserted.
source_ids: An overview of free nilpotent Lie algebras (Benito–de-la-Concepción, 2014)
title: Characteristic-two orbit jump and complete rank census of idempotent derivations of free two-step Lie algebras
